main_text.p: 12 Omnes vrbes regum iftorum, & vniuerfos reges earū cepit Iofue, percufsitque eos acie gladii, perdēdo eos ficuti præceperat Moses feruus Iehouæ.
13 Tātuminodo omnes vrbes quæ manebant in ftatu fuo non combuffit Ifrael, præter Hafor folam, quam cōbufsit Iofue.

14 Et omnia fpolia vrbium iftarū, & iumēta prædati funt fibi filii Ifrael: veruntamē omnes homines percuf-ferunt acie gladii quoufque perderēt eos: non reliquerunt vllam animam, quemadmodum præceperat Iehoua Mofi feruo fuo: fic præcepit Moses Iofue, & Iofue fic fecit, vt non omitteret quidquam ex omnibus quæ præceperat Iehoua Mofi.
1 Quum audiffet Iabin.) In hac quoque noua confpiratione iterum refulget plufquam paterna Dei cura in præcauendis fuorum periculis, fimulque in leuanda infirmitate indulgentia & huma-

page.notes: The foot note is continued at the bottom of the page and breaks off at "huma-" (humanitas); the start of the note marker "1" and italic "Quum audiffet Iabin." are as printed. Verse numbers 12–14 are printed in the text.
